proposal.summary: Multiple command injection vulnerabilities in the PAPI UDP service (port 8211) allow unauthenticated attackers to send specially crafted packets that lead to remote code execution as a privileged user on the underlying OS.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Identify affected product(s) and version(s), obtain packet captures or PoC samples, and attempt to reproduce the issue against an isolated test instance of the PAPI service on UDP port 8211.
